task.title: Make filename glob limitations explicit and tested
task.problem: Filename matching implements a smaller glob dialect than rg; brace and negative include syntax can silently mean something different.
task.proposal: Define a shared documented subset and reject unsupported filename patterns clearly; decide whether full parity is worth an added library after differential tests.
acceptance: A table covers basename, slash, **, classes, dotfiles, case rules, include unions and exclusion precedence.
Unsupported brace/negative patterns never silently produce plausible wrong results.
CAS and FUSE filename modes agree for the supported subset.
